purpose: Dynamic risk matrix for CYNIC-governed external projects. Scores each project across five risk factors (language, secrets, network, build, trust tier) using a weighted sum. Recompute composite_risk_score whenever any factor level changes. JSON only; no code.

risk_factors.description: Inherent risk of the project's primary language stack (memory safety, type safety, supply-chain surface).

levels.criteria: Memory-safe language with strong tooling and minimal unsafe surface (e.g. Rust).
Memory-safe, simple language with small stdlib surface (e.g. Go).
Managed/runtime language with moderate supply-chain surface (e.g. TypeScript/Node, C#).
Dynamic interpreted language with large runtime surface (e.g. Python, Ruby, Shell).
Unknown or unpinned language with no observed manifest or toolchain.

risk_factors.description: Exposure and sensitivity of secrets/credentials/key material the project handles or requires.

levels.criteria: No secrets; public-only data and no credentials.
Revocable scoped tokens or references only; no raw secret values in CYNIC.
Static API keys or service credentials present in the project.
Stored user credentials or database secrets.
Private key material, fee-payer signers, treasury keys, or on-chain signing authority.

risk_factors.description: Network exposure and reachability of the project (offline to on-chain money movement).

levels.criteria: No network access; local CLI or library only.
Localhost-only HTTP/MCP/IPC; no remote reachability.
Private network or VPC surfaces; REST endpoints behind auth.
Public internet-facing service or API.
On-chain transaction submission, sponsored relay, or value transfer.

risk_factors.description: Observed build/test reliability on the builder (10.10.10.119).

levels.criteria: Build and tests pass on builder with read-back proof.
Build green; minor environment-dependent or timing-sensitive test failures.
Partial build (platform-specific constraints) or env-dependent test failures.
Commands inferred from manifest; not yet run/verified on builder.
Build broken or project quarantined/deprecated.

risk_factors.description: Trust tier of the project and its collaborators (observed, promoted, or quarantined).

levels.criteria: Operator-owned, core trust (constituent).
Upstream or operator project with demonstrated reliability/adoption.
Default for new collaborators/projects; read-only until promoted with proof.
New or unverified actor with no proof record.
Deprecated or quarantined project.

scoring.formula: composite_risk_score = sum(factor_weight * factor_score) over the five risk factors; weights sum to 1.0.

risk_bands.action: observe; standard review cadence. Quorum: 1 signature (operator go suffices).
review before any port wiring or mutation. Quorum: 2 signatures.
require read-back proof and operator approval before use. Quorum: 3 signatures.
quarantine or restrict to read-only observation. No use quorum; lifting quarantine requires 3 signatures.

rules: Composite score is a weighted sum of the five risk factors; weights sum to 1.0.
Recompute composite_risk_score and risk_band whenever any factor level changes (dynamic).
Higher score means higher risk. 1 = lowest, 5 = highest.
Risk band thresholds: low <=2.0, medium 2.01-3.0, high 3.01-4.0, critical >=4.01.
No mutation or port wiring for projects in high/critical band without read-back proof and operator approval.

Quorum by band: low = 1 signature (operator go suffices), medium = 2, high = 3; a signature is an operator go or an independent green proof/review. Critical admits no use quorum; lifting quarantine requires 3 signatures.
Quarantined projects (holdex) remain read-only observation only.
Secrets never enter CYNIC repo or prompts; CYNIC holds references only.
